title: Cockles and Mussels
commons_title: File:Cockles and Mussels - Celtic Aire - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: traditional Irish song, 'Molly Malone', 19th century; public domain
credit: Performance by Celtic Aire, United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: In Dublin's fair city, where the girls are so pretty
I first set my eyes on sweet Molly Malone
As she wheeled her wheelbarrow through streets broad and narrow
Crying cockles and mussels, alive, alive, oh
Alive, alive, oh, alive, alive, oh
Crying cockles and mussels, alive, alive, oh
